applies_to: Glorius group papers on photocatalysis and energy transfer

signature_features: panel titles in crop 01 are bold italic with a parenthesised capital letter, e.g. (A) Reagent synthesis, above a dashed horizontal rule; the other crops differ: crop 04 bold italic without a letter, crop 05 bold upright without parentheses, crop 06 regular weight with parenthesised letters under a solid rule
energy-transfer step in the concept panel (crop 02) drawn as a cyan lamp icon #41ABE7 on the arrow next to a circled EnT with a circular arrow
the two reagent fragments colour-coded: oxime/aryl part in very dark red-brown #2C0001, silyl part in blue #0203FE
multistep conditions as numbered lines (i), (ii) split above and below one long arrow
atom labels and compound labels in bold Arial-like sans serif; yields as 3a, 69% (70%) with NMR yield in parentheses

notes.new_bond_color: red new C-C bonds #F82D30 only in the Chem. Sci. mechanism crop (06); not seen in the JACS crops
notes.highlight_fill: No single highlight. Crop 02 marks the reacting CH2 with mint dots (flat shades #9BF5C8 and #89EDC7; #92F2C4 lies between them). These are atom halos, not ring fills. Crop 03 fills the product core ring with #DEE2E5. The highlight_fill key fills product rings, so the scheme and mechanism sections record the dots as a signature and leave the key unset.
notes.substrate_colors: Reaction-scheme convention: crops 01 and 02 (same paper) only; not applied to the scope, mechanism, catalytic-cycle or energy-profile crops. #2C0001 is the aryl/oxime part (the aryl groups of product 2 in crop 01 and of reagent 2 in crop 02); #0203FE is the silyl part (S1 and S3 in crop 01, the O-CH2-Si unit of reagent 2 in crop 02). Alkene 1 stays black.
notes.measurement: bond/cap 2.2, 2.3, 2.1 in crops 01, 03, 05; JACS figures were measured on the 3792 to 4192 px PMC originals
notes.conditions_split: No value. Crop 01 splits the conditions by step: the reagents and DMF sit above step (i) and Et2O is below step (ii). Crop 03 puts all its conditions above the arrow. The crops disagree, so no value is set.
notes.abbreviate_groups: Me is labelled on silicon (SiMe2 in crops 01 and 02). Gem-dimethyl groups on carbon rings are drawn as bare bonds with no label (crops 03 and 04).
notes.line_width_over_bond_length: Per-crop ratios: 0.078 (crop 01, 7 px over 90 px), 0.063 (crop 03, 5 over 80) and 0.083 (crop 05, 6 over 72). The median, 0.078, is used; the earlier 0.075 was their mean.

evidence.citation: Gutierrez, Glorius et al., J. Am. Chem. Soc. 2024 (gamma-Amino alcohols via energy transfer enabled Brook rearrangement)
evidence.observations: reagent synthesis: two numbered steps (i)/(ii) above and below one long arrow; blue #0203FE silyl fragment, bold S1/S3 labels, dashed rule under the bold italic (A) Reagent synthesis title, dashed box around S5

evidence.citation: Gutierrez, Glorius et al., J. Am. Chem. Soc. 2024 (gamma-Amino alcohols via energy transfer enabled Brook rearrangement)
evidence.observations: concept panel: lamp icon (bulb #41ABE7, rays #6BCFE6) + circled EnT with circular arrow on the arrow, persistent/transient radical captions in italic, Brook rearrangement in bold italic navy #01027F, mint dots #92F2C4 on the migrating CH2, dashed boxed general reaction

evidence.citation: Glorius et al., J. Am. Chem. Soc. 2025 (Cyclic bifunctional reagents enabling a strain-release-driven formal [3+2] cycloaddition)
evidence.observations: scope: scheme on top (Ir-F above arrow; PhCF3, blue LEDs, RT, 3 h below), core ring in dark green #0B5234 with pale fill, section tabs Alkenes etc. bold italic on mint #73EDB0, dashed separators, labels 3a, 69% (70%)

evidence.citation: Glorius et al., J. Am. Chem. Soc. 2025 (Cyclic bifunctional reagents enabling a strain-release-driven formal [3+2] cycloaddition)
evidence.observations: DFT energy profile: thick black level bars joined by solid lines for the main path, grey #859795 dashed for the competing path, values as dG over (dE) in kcal/mol, superscript multiplicity labels such as 3TS-1, circled EnT steps, spin densities on pink #EB659D dots, bold italic DFT Studies title with rule

evidence.citation: Wenger, Glorius et al., J. Am. Chem. Soc. 2025 (Phenothiazine sulfoxides as active photocatalysts for the synthesis of gamma-lactones)
evidence.observations: photocatalytic cycle: closed loop of black curved arrows, step names SET in bold italic dark red #7E2228, potentials E1/2 in dark red, boxed quantum yield in the centre, violet lamp #6331BC for excitation

evidence.citation: Glorius et al., Chem. Sci. 2023 (Metal-free photosensitized radical relay 1,4-carboimination across two distinct olefins)
evidence.observations: radical relay mechanism (low-resolution RSC figure): EnT over arrow, -CO2 below, new C-C bonds red #F82D30, bold intermediate labels A, B, IM1, IM2, italic descriptors under species, no curved electron-pushing arrows

signature_features: silyl reagents S1 and S3 blue (#0203FE) throughout, including Cl or HO, CH2, Si, Me and R; in reagent 2 and product 2 the blue starts at the O-CH2 of the carbonate; aryl/oxime part dark red-brown #2C0001
two-step sequences written as (i) and (ii) lines, one above and one below a single long arrow
dashed rectangle drawn around one box: the reagent S5 in crop 01, or the whole general reaction (1 + 2 to 3) in crop 02
mint dots #92F2C4 on the reacting CH2 of reagent 2 and of product 3 (crop 02), drawn on the atom rather than as a ring fill
reaction_scheme.notes: variation colour agrees in crops 01 and 02 (same paper); yield_format is null because neither crop shows a yield (the yield format is in substrate_scope, crop 03); the conditions split by step is in crop 01 only.

signature_features: general scheme on top with coloured dots marking the substituent positions, then one row of products: 3a, the X-ray entry, 3b to 3f drawn once as a core with an R list, then 3g, 3h and 3i
substrate classes introduced by bold italic labels on mint tabs #73EDB0 at the left of dashed horizontal separators
conserved product core drawn in dark green #0B5234 with a pale grey fill #DEE2E5 inside the ring
yield line 3a, 69% (70%) with isolated yield then NMR yield in parentheses
substrate_scope.notes: one crop; the conventions are unambiguous in it. selectivity_format is null because no d.r. is shown. highlight_fill is the product core ring fill (#DEE2E5), the key the tool applies; the mint section tabs (#73EDB0) are signature features, not a highlight. scope_layout is kept as grid_with_core, the nearest value, but crop 03 is one row with one shared 3b to 3f core, not a two-dimensional grid.

signature_features: energy transfer drawn as lamp icon #41ABE7 plus a circled EnT with a circular arrow on the reaction arrow (crop 02); in the Chem. Sci. figure as the word EnT above the arrow with -CO2 below (crop 06)

radicals named by italic captions under the structure: persistent and transient in crop 02; persistent (ambiphilic) and transient (nucleophilic) in crop 06. In crop 02 the short-lived and stabilised radicals 2' and 2'' have roman captions beside the structures
newly formed C-C bonds in red #F82D30 (crop 06)
radical steps shown with straight reaction arrows, no electron-pushing curved arrows
mint dots #92F2C4 on the migrating CH2 of the Brook rearrangement (crop 02), drawn on the atom, not as a ring fill
mechanism.notes: no curved electron-pushing arrows in either crop, so arrow colour and weight are not set; crop 06 mixes bold letters (A, B) with IM1 and IM2; crop 02 labels its intermediates 2' and 2''; no single intermediate label style, so it is not set

signature_features: cycle closed by black curved arrows with substrates entering and leaving on side arcs
step names (SET) in bold italic dark red #7E2228 beside the arcs, with E1/2 values in dark red below
boxed centre label giving the quantum yield (Phi rxn = 0.55)
violet lamp icon #6331BC on a pair of equilibrium arrows for photoexcitation of the catalyst
main pathway as black bars and solid connectors; competing pathway as grey #859795 bars with dashed connectors
each level labelled with bold species name with superscript multiplicity (3TS-1, 3IM-1) above two values: dG and (dE) in parentheses
vertical axis drawn as a bare upward arrow labelled dG (dE) in kcal/mol, no tick marks
stage brackets under the x axis with italic names (Isoxazolone ring contraction, Olefin insertion into azirine)
inset boxes with thin grey frames for competing transition states; spin densities on pink #EB659D circles
pale grey ring fill #DEE2E5 on the isoxazolone 1a ring and the product 13a ring; dark green #244E41 bonds on the 13a core; a double-slash break mark on the connector from MECP-2 to 13a
energy_profile.notes: one crop; transition states are named TS in the label, not marked with a double dagger
